passage:
monitor — 监测；监控
Chen, said, "We cannot test every street, so we must choose our methods carefully." The team compared three ways to monitor air quality: low-cost sensors, official monitoring stations, and simple dust traps.

accurate — 准确的
However, because they are cheap, they may not be very accurate.

compared — 比较
Chen, said, "We cannot test every street, so we must choose our methods carefully." The team compared three ways to monitor air quality: low-cost sensors, official monitoring stations, and simple dust traps.

expensive — 昂贵的
[C] Official monitoring stations are large and expensive.

Therefore — 因此
Therefore, the team could not use station data to answer questions about the building site.

Although — 虽然；尽管
Chen said, "Although the stations are excellent, they cannot tell us about our street."

surface — 表面
A dust trap is a box with a sticky surface.

support — 支持
The team hopes the council will support a second project with more sensors next year.
